text:
micah-sales: FYI AcmeSystems wants to proceed with the POC but procurement asked for EIN on the PO and a vendor W-9 before countersign. They also want a named signer for Finance (title + email).
procurement-jess: Standard ask. We can accept W-9 + PO with EIN populated. If they prefer, we can accept a scanned W-9 emailed by their finance contact. Need explicit signer mapping on PO (procurement contact + finance approver).
micah-sales: They also included a short clause request: 'Vendor confirms authorized to invoice and registered in US.' Is a one-line attestation OK?
rebecca-legal: One-line attestation is fine for a POC as long as it doesn't amend payment or SLA terms. Suggested wording: 'Redwood Inference, Inc. is authorized to invoice AcmeSystems, Inc. using EIN XX-XXXXXXX.' Keep it an attachment, not embedded into the PO terms.
billing-bot: Heads-up: invoices lacking TIN/EIN or vendor onboarding docs will be queued and may be delayed past net terms. See onboarding checklist: https://redwood.example/vendor/onboard
micah-sales: Who can assemble DocuSign? Would rather send PO + W-9 request + attestation in one envelope.
docsign-bot: DocuSign queue: set envelope to signers [Acme Procurement, Acme Finance]. Draft created template: 'PO + W-9 request + Attestation'.
oliver-csm: After sign, I'll upload to Zendesk POC-789 and create a short runbook entry for deletion steps if they require POC data removal.
rebecca-legal: If buyer suddenly asks for a DPA change or to shorten liability, escalate to legal. For now, we can provide a limited attestation and W-9.
procurement-jess: I'll confirm remittance method (ACH vs wire) and ask for remittance address. Also request approver name/title so we map signers correctly.
micah-sales: Thanks team. I'll update Acme and send DocuSign once I have approver name. Will loop in @rebecca-legal for final wording sign-off before sending.
